label: Being able to be without another has an accessible existence witness (CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1)
paraphrase: OPEN realization assumption at the supplied origin: whenever x can be without y, some world accessible from the origin in the shared ontology has x existing and y absent. This assumes only the realization direction. Its consequent is CAN_BE_WITHOUT_1 (beingWithoutHasAccessibleWitness_iff); its antecedent keeps the undifferentiated relation of DEF-CAN-BE-WITHOUT, so it is the route's only passage into sense 1 (disambiguation d3808588). If being-without is read through another's power (CAN_BE_WITHOUT_2), it requires every contrast some power can bring about to be realized at an accessible world.
